definition.name: pwa_chat_models_default_v1
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_chat_models_default_v1(actor jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE partner text:=public.pwa_chat_actor_v1(actor);
BEGIN
 RETURN (SELECT t.model FROM public.pwa_chat_threads t WHERE t.partner_id=partner AND t.status<>'deleted' ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 1);
END $function$
definition.comment: mw-access:governance fixed chat boundary; explicit capability only
